gender.updated: Gender updated; the next image generation will apply it
gender.title: Character gender (GENDER LOCK): avoids generating the wrong gender

anchor.title: Appearance anchor
anchor.description: This is the shared source for every image: three views, expressions, assets and panels. Edit once and later generations sync.
anchor.aiPlaceholder: (Optional) Tell AI what to change, e.g. rounder face, younger, like a period-drama youth
anchor.appearancePlaceholder: Describe features, skin tone, hairstyle, age, build and recognizable traits...
anchor.faceOverridePlaceholder: Blank = off. e.g. full rounded face, soft non-pointed chin
anchor.presets: Facial-structure quick notes (click to set or append to the override):
anchor.empty: This character has no appearance anchor yet.
anchor.saved: Appearance anchor saved; the next image generation will apply it
anchor.adopted: AI's suggestion applied; review and save

generation.sheetDescription: Front, side, back and face crop help lock the character's appearance.
generation.sheetEmptyDescription: Generate the main sheet first, then continue with the expression sheet and reference panels.
generation.expressionDescription: Common expressions serve as emotion references when generating panels.
generation.expressionFailed: Failed to generate the expression sheet
generation.expressionEmpty: After generating the three views, you can generate 6 core expressions.
generation.tuningDescription: Edit the prompt then regenerate; on success the new one replaces the main sheet.
generation.tuningNotice: Regular tuning only changes style, outfit details or pose; face shape, hairstyle and recognizable traits stay locked to the appearance anchor.
generation.promptPlaceholder: Enter the prompt for this three-views generation
generation.recommendedPrompt: Suggested prompt filled in; you can fine-tune then generate.
generation.useReference: Use this three-views image as a reference
generation.appearancePlaceholder: Add keywords to lock appearance, e.g. hairstyle, eyes, build, outfit and recognizable traits
generation.appearanceNotice: With keywords filled in, the system prioritizes keeping these traits during generation.
generation.tuningUnavailable: Generate the three views first; the system saves the prompt and lets you tune based on the current image.
